title: Great Tour of Sacromonte and Albaicin
text: Our guide was Antonio. He was very knowledgeable about Sacromonte and Albaicin areas and gave us a really good history of the areas. We had a small group and enjoyed visiting the museum in Sacromonte. He was extremely friendly and offered lots of tips on where to go in Granada. Great morning. Thank you Antonio.
author: Joanne_B

title: Our tour guide was...
text: Our tour guide was amazing! It ended up just being my mom and myself on the tour. We were running late and the guide waited for us and I am so glad she did as the tour was so interesting. You can really see the passion she had for this tour, it was really enjoyable.
author: Ashley_B

title: A wonderful historical tour in Granada!
text: Francisco was very knowledgeable about the history of Granada. We learned so much about the gypsies of Spain, their culture and toured the beautiful neighborhood of Albacin. It was a wonderful historical tour and would definitely recommend to others.
author: Jennifer_R

title: Interesting tour!
text: Great tour! Maria was interesting and passionate about Granada and its history. Learned a lot. Loved it!
author: Nathalie_B

title: Tour with Lorena
text: Guided tour by Lorena, we really liked her closeness and her naturalness. The best tour we have ever done! We will repeat. Thank you for the respect you have for history. And thanks for instilling it.
author: Meander18863637793

title: Superb little museum, gave a real insight into life in these caves
text:
This was a highlight of our visit to Granada - don't miss it, was a contrast to the grandeur of Alhmabra. Bargain at €5 each.
Easy to get to by bus (from Plaza Nueva, get off at 89 Sacromonte and return from the same stop) though a steep walk up from the stop to the museum.  Bus just 0.44€ if using the Credibus card (€2 fee for €5 card which you can use for multiple people) or €1.40 single ticket.  
11 caves furnished as homes, stables, forge etc with excellent information boards in Spanish and English and videos too.  
Views out across to Alhambra from outside the museum, and spotless toilet
author: TrewinDorset

title: The stories Juana told us...
text: The stories Juana told us and the breathtaking views. She’s very informative and we really lesrned a lot about the 2 beautiful cities
author: Gloria_M

title: Loved the guide and walking tour
text: The guide was really really great. Sacromonte and Albaicin are really fun places for a walking tour. I found the caves themselves a bit disappointing though, though no fault of the guide, the history just isn't that rich. So all and all it was worth it if only for the fun walking tour of the Albaicin with a very knowledgeable guide.
author: jameisonm2018
